description: PortableLM MCP Fast 3.2 tool registry. All tools are sandboxed, permission-scoped, and audit-logged.

tools.name: Shell Executor
tools.description: Run shell commands in a sandboxed subprocess. Output captured and returned.

tools.name: File Reader
tools.description: Read files from the USB drive within allowed paths only.

tools.name: File Writer
tools.description: Write files to the USB drive. Restricted to Shared/output/ directory only.

tools.name: Nuclei Scanner
tools.description: Run Nuclei templates against authorized targets. Requires target authorization confirmation before execution.

tools.name: Sigma Rule Generator
tools.description: Generate Sigma detection rules from threat intel, IOCs, or attack behaviour descriptions.

tools.name: YARA Scanner
tools.description: Scan files against YARA rules for malware indicators.

tools.name: MITRE ATT&CK Lookup
tools.description: Map TTPs to MITRE ATT&CK techniques, sub-techniques, mitigations, and data sources. Works fully offline.

tools.name: Web Fetch / OSINT
tools.description: Fetch URLs for OSINT, CVE lookups, and threat intel enrichment from approved domains only.

tools.name: CVE / NVD Lookup
tools.description: Look up CVE details, CVSS scores, affected products, and available patches from NVD.

tools.name: File Hash Checker
tools.description: Compute MD5/SHA1/SHA256 of files. Optionally check against threat intel feeds.

tools.name: Port Scanner (Authorized Targets Only)
tools.description: Run a port scan against an explicitly authorized target. Requires scope confirmation before execution.

tools.name: Report Generator
tools.description: Generate structured security reports in Markdown, HTML, or JSON from session findings.
